fields.id: stable row-local id after deterministic component ordering
fields.identity_signature: color-aware shape identity used for matching

admission_requires: all transition grids have one 2-D shape
candidate is a thin frame-edge strip
some before/after strip has a dominant color covering at least 75%
at least one observed transition changes cells only inside that strip
hud_rejection_rules.fail_open: no strip is admitted when these conditions are not all met
hud_rejection_rules.rejection_scope: only components wholly inside the admitted strip are removed

fields.after_components: components from the after grid after HUD rejection
fields.before_components: components from the before grid after HUD rejection
fields.created_after_components: after components with no admitted match
fields.relations: pairwise relative-centroid deltas among matched components
fields.removed_before_components: before components with no admitted match
